title: {{ .service }} · backlog growing at max consumers
description: Consumers are at the autoscaler maximum ({{ .max_consumers }}) and the backlog keeps growing: a capacity problem. Runbook: {{ .runbook }}

input.value:
timeseries { backlog = max(<queue backlog metric>), consumers = max(k8s.hpa.current_replicas) }, filter:{ service.name == "{{ .service }}" }, interval:5m
| fieldsAdd growing_at_max = iCollectArray(if(consumers[] >= {{ .max_consumers }} and backlog[] > backlog[-1], 1, else: 0))
| fields timeframe, interval, growing_at_max

properties.value: {{ .service }}: backlog grows while consumers are at max
